svg.title: What happens when you call analyzeCompany()
svg.desc: Your numbers go into analyzeCompany. Step 1 checks inputs: missing fields, division by zero, NaN and meaningless ratios become null. Step 2 computes ratios, for example P/E 28.67 and ROE 1.199. Step 3 rates each one against generic thresholds with a plain-English insight. Step 4 returns a typed result grouped into seven categories.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
